svg.title: Q4 crowded portfolio
svg.desc: Risk-return view. Independent baseline: 49% lose money, median outcome 0. Shared-outcome stress: 51% lose money, median outcome −100. The horizontal axis is odds of success; the vertical axis is per-bet P50 expected value. Probability threshold labels mark odds ranges at or below 10%, or at or above 90%.
svg.text: HIGH ODDS OF SUCCESS: 90% OR MORE
LOW ODDS OF SUCCESS: 10% OR LESS
4 of 12 bets carry their number on the plot; B02–B04, B06–B08, B11–B12 (8) are in the key only.
PER-BET P50 EV · P10–P90 RANGES · 40,000 SIMULATIONS
